description: Continuous enhancements and optimizations for LUMA storefront

userStories.title: Verify build and component integrity
userStories.description: Ensure the application builds cleanly with Vite without any bundling or JSX syntax errors.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build executes with exit code 0
No unresolved module imports or assets
Clean production bundle generated in dist/

userStories.title: Add cart badge item count indicator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the total quantity of items currently in my cart on the navigation bar cart button.
acceptanceCriteria: Navbar cart icon displays a badge with count when cart has items
Badge updates dynamically when items are added

userStories.title: Add smooth scroll navigation anchors
userStories.description: As a user, clicking navigation links (Products, Science, FAQ, Reviews) smoothly scrolls to the matching section.
acceptanceCriteria: Sections have matching IDs (products, technology, faq, reviews)
Navbar and Mobile Drawer links scroll smoothly to corresponding sections
